# M1 data report (auto-generated by `python -m scout.data.report`)

## Club at the snapshot date

Match rate = share of players whose reconstructed club on 1 September equals the club they played their next league game for within 60 days (validation only; the features never look after t). Some misses are real moves made after 1 September, especially in 2020, when the transfer window stayed open until October.

- `transfers`: last transfer on or before t (the SPEC's first choice). Fails early on because the transfers table is incomplete before about 2021.
- `august_then_transfers`: last league appearance since 1 August, else transfers (the first fallback).
- `latest_evidence` (**used**, `latest_evidence`): most recent of the last league appearance, last transfer and the club on the last valuation, all dated on or before t.

## Is `player_valuations.current_club_id` point-in-time?

Yes. It records the club at the valuation date, not the player's current club:

- players with >1 valuation club (players with a transfer): 85.5%
- transfers checked (2013–2024, valuations within 365 d on both sides): 73,697
- last valuation before the transfer shows the old club: 78.2%
- first valuation after the transfer shows the new club: 78.1%
- valuation club changes across the transfer: 89.6%

## Usable snapshots under both target definitions

`usable_asof_target`: the SPEC target (latest valuation on or before the next 1 September, with at least one new valuation in between). `usable_v0_window`: v0's rule (first valuation 335–425 days after t). Revaluations bunch in particular months, so the fixed v0 window misses most annual snapshots.
